corrections.reason: The fourth-order Fidel ካ (እስካለው, 'up to where it says') is clearly printed with a shortened left leg and longer right leg, and is required by Amharic grammar.
Visual inspection of the zoomed image shows እንኳን ('even by month and by day he likens it'), where ኳን was misread as ዲህ.
Line 25 begins with the single character ኗ completing በማኅፀኗ from line 24, followed by ተቀርፆዋል.
